<!DOCTYPE html>

<html lang="en">

<head>

<meta charset="UTF-8">

<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">

<title>Ledger — Personal Finance</title>

<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">

<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Fraunces:opsz,wght@9..144,400;9..144,500;9..144,600;9..144,700&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&family=IBM+Plex+Mono:wght@400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">

<style>

  :root{

    --bg:#0D1117;

    --surface:#141B22;

    --surface-alt:#1A222B;

    --raised:#202932;

    --border:#2A333D;

    --border-soft:#232C35;

    --gold:#C9A227;

    --gold-soft:#8f7422;

    --green:#4FB286;

    --green-dim:#2c4c40;

    --rust:#BD5A42;

    --rust-dim:#4a332c;

    --text:#ECE9E2;

    --text-dim:#9CA5B3;

    --text-faint:#5D6773;

    --radius:10px;

    --serif:'Fraunces', serif;

    --sans:'Inter', sans-serif;

    --mono:'IBM Plex Mono', monospace;

  }

  *{box-sizing:border-box;min-width:0;}

  html,body{margin:0;padding:0;max-width:100%;overflow-x:hidden;}

  body{

    background:var(--bg);

    color:var(--text);

    font-family:var(--sans);

    font-size:14.5px;

    line-height:1.5;

    -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;

  }

  img,svg{max-width:100%;}

  ::selection{background:var(--gold-soft);color:#fff;}

  ::-webkit-scrollbar{width:10px;height:10px;}

  ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:var(--border);border-radius:6px;}

  ::-webkit-scrollbar-track{background:transparent;}



  a{color:inherit;}

  button{font-family:inherit;cursor:pointer;}

  input,select{font-family:inherit;}



  /* ---------- Layout shell ---------- */

  .shell{display:flex;min-height:100vh;max-width:100%;overflow-x:hidden;}



  .sidebar{

    width:236px;

    flex-shrink:0;

    background:var(--surface-alt);

    border-right:1px solid var(--border-soft);

    display:flex;

    flex-direction:column;

    padding:22px 14px;

    position:fixed;

    top:0;left:0;bottom:0;

    transition:transform .25s ease;

    z-index:40;

  }

  .brand{

    display:flex;

    align-items:baseline;

    gap:8px;

    padding:4px 10px 22px 10px;

    border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-soft);

    margin-bottom:14px;

  }

  .brand-mark{

    font-family:var(--serif);

    font-weight:600;

    font-size:22px;

    color:var(--gold);

    letter-spacing:.3px;

  }

  .brand-sub{

    font-size:11px;

    color:var(--text-faint);

    font-family:var(--mono);

  }



  .nav-group-label{

    font-size:11px;

    color:var(--text-faint);

    padding:16px 12px 6px;

  }

  .nav-item{

    display:flex;

    align-items:center;

    gap:11px;

    padding:9px 12px;

    border-radius:8px;

    color:var(--text-dim);

    text-decoration:none;

    font-size:14px;

    font-weight:500;

    border-left:2px solid transparent;

    background:none;

    border:none;

    width:100%;

    text-align:left;

    margin-bottom:2px;

    position:relative;

  }

  .nav-item svg{width:17px;height:17px;flex-shrink:0;opacity:.85;}

  .nav-item:hover{background:var(--raised);color:var(--text);}

  .nav-item.active{

    background:var(--raised);

    color:var(--text);

    border-left:2px solid var(--gold);

  }

  .nav-item.disabled{

    color:var(--text-faint);

    cursor:default;

  }

  .nav-item.disabled:hover{background:none;color:var(--text-faint);}

  .nav-soon{

    margin-left:auto;

    font-size:9.5px;

    font-family:var(--mono);

    color:var(--text-faint);

    border:1px solid var(--border);

    padding:1px 5px;

    border-radius:20px;

    letter-spacing:.3px;

  }



  .sidebar-foot{

    margin-top:auto;

    padding:12px 10px 2px;

    border-top:1px solid var(--border-soft);

    font-size:11.5px;

    color:var(--text-faint);

  }



  .main{

    margin-left:236px;

    flex:1;

    min-width:0;

    width:100%;

    max-width:100%;

    overflow-x:hidden;

    display:flex;

    flex-direction:column;

  }



  .topbar{

    display:flex;

    align-items:center;

    justify-content:space-between;

    padding:20px 30px;

    border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-soft);

    position:sticky;

    top:0;

    background:rgba(13,17,23,.92);

    backdrop-filter:blur(6px);

    z-index:20;

  }

  .page-title{

    font-family:var(--serif);

    font-size:25px;

    font-weight:600;

    margin:0;

  }

  .page-sub{

    color:var(--text-faint);

    font-size:12.5px;

    margin-top:2px;

  }

  .topbar-right{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;}

  .today-date{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--text-dim);font-family:var(--mono);}



  .bell-wrap{position:relative;}

  .bell-btn{

    background:var(--surface);

    border:1px solid var(--border);

    width:36px;height:36px;

    border-radius:9px;

    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;

    color:var(--text-dim);

  }

  .bell-btn:hover{color:var(--text);border-color:var(--gold-soft);}

  .bell-btn svg{width:17px;height:17px;}

  .bell-dot{

    position:absolute;top:-4px;right:-4px;

    background:var(--rust);

    color:#fff;

    font-size:9.5px;

    font-family:var(--mono);

    min-width:15px;height:15px;

    border-radius:8px;

    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;

    padding:0 3px;

    border:2px solid var(--bg);

  }



  .content{

    padding:26px 30px 60px;

    flex:1;

    min-width:0;

    max-width:100%;

    overflow-x:hidden;

  }



  .menu-toggle{display:none;}



  /* ---------- Dashboard ---------- */

  .stat-row{

    display:grid;

    grid-template-columns:1.3fr 1fr 1fr;

    gap:14px;

    margin-bottom:22px;

  }

  .stat-card{

    background:var(--surface);

    border:1px solid var(--border-soft);

    border-radius:var(--radius);

    padding:20px 22px;

  }

  .stat-card.hero{

    background:linear-gradient(155deg, var(--surface) 0%, #171F27 100%);

    border-color:var(--border);

  }

  .stat-label{

    color:var(--text-faint);

    font-size:12px;

    margin-bottom:10px;

  }

  .stat-value{

    font-family:var(--mono);

    font-size:30px;

    font-weight:600;

    letter-spacing:-.5px;

  }

  .stat-value.small{font-size:22px;}

  .stat-value.pos{color:var(--green);}

  .stat-value.neg{color:var(--rust);}

  .stat-foot{

    margin-top:8px;

    font-size:12px;

    color:var(--text-dim);

  }

  .stat-split{

    display:flex;

    flex-wrap:wrap;

    gap:14px 22px;

    margin-top:14px;

    padding-top:14px;

    border-top:1px solid var(--border-soft);

  }

  .stat-split div{flex:1;}

  .stat-split .k{font-size:11px;color:var(--text-faint);margin-bottom:3px;}

  .stat-split .v{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:15px;font-weight:600;}



  button.stat-card{

    text-align:left;

    width:100%;

    font:inherit;

    color:inherit;

    cursor:pointer;

    appearance:none;

    -webkit-appearance:none;

    transition:border-color .15s ease, transform .08s ease;

  }

  button.stat-card:hover{border-color:var(--gold-soft);}

  button.stat-card:active{transform:scale(0.98);}



  .progress-track{height:6px;background:var(--border-soft);border-radius:4px;overflow:hidden;margin-top:10px;}

  .progress-fill{height:100%;background:var(--gold);border-radius:4px;}



  .emi-row{

    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;

    padding:13px 20px;margin:0 -20px;

    border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-soft);

    cursor:pointer;

  }

  .emi-row:last-child{border-bottom:none;}

  .emi-row:hover{background:var(--surface-alt);}

  .emi-row .er-left{flex:1;min-width:0;}

  .emi-row .er-name{font-weight:600;font-size:13.5px;margin-bottom:3px;}

  .emi-row .er-sub{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--text-faint);}

  .emi-row .er-right{text-align:right;flex-shrink:0;}

  .emi-row .er-amt{font-family:var(--mono);font-weight:600;font-size:14px;}

  .emi-row .er-days{font-size:11px;margin-top:2px;}

  .emi-row .er-days.soon{color:var(--rust);font-weight:600;}

  .emi-row .er-days.normal{color:var(--text-faint);}



  .panel{

    background:var(--surface);

    border:1px solid var(--border-soft);

    border-radius:var(--radius);

    margin-bottom:20px;

  }

  .panel-head{

    display:flex;

    align-items:center;

    justify-content:space-between;

    padding:16px 20px;

    border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-soft);

  }

  .panel-head h3{

    margin:0;

    font-family:var(--serif);

    font-weight:600;

    font-size:17px;

  }

  .panel-body{padding:6px 20px 14px;}



  .notif-row{

    display:flex;

    gap:12px;

    padding:12px 0;

    border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-soft);

    align-items:flex-start;

  }

  .notif-row:last-child{border-bottom:none;}

  .notif-dot{

    width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;

    margin-top:6px;flex-shrink:0;

  }

  .notif-dot.warn{background:var(--rust);}

  .notif-dot.info{background:var(--gold);}

  .notif-dot.ok{background:var(--green);}

  .notif-text{font-size:13.5px;}

  .notif-text b{font-weight:600;}

  .notif-time{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--text-faint);margin-top:2px;}

  .empty-note{

    color:var(--text-faint);

    font-size:13px;

    padding:18px 0;

  }



  .quick-grid{

    display:grid;

    grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);

    gap:12px;

  }

  .quick-card{

    background:var(--surface-alt);

    border:1px solid var(--border-soft);

    border-radius:9px;

    padding:16px 18px;

    text-align:left;

  }

  .quick-card:hover{border-color:var(--gold-soft);}

  .quick-card .qc-title{font-weight:600;font-size:14px;margin-bottom:3px;}

  .quick-card .qc-sub{font-size:12px;color:var(--text-faint);}

  .quick-card.locked{opacity:.55;cursor:default;}

  .quick-card.locked:hover{border-color:var(--border-soft);}



  /* ---------- Loans module ---------- */

  .tab-row{

    display:flex;

    gap:6px;

    background:var(--surface-alt);

    border:1px solid var(--border-soft);

    border-radius:9px;

    padding:4px;

    width:fit-content;

    margin-bottom:18px;

  }

  .tab-btn{

    background:none;border:none;

    padding:8px 18px;

    border-radius:6px;

    font-size:13.5px;

    font-weight:600;

    color:var(--text-dim);

  }

  .tab-btn.active{background:var(--raised);color:var(--text);}

  .tab-btn.active.borrowed{color:var(--rust);}

  .tab-btn.active.lent{color:var(--green);}



  .module-head{

    display:flex;

    flex-wrap:wrap;

    justify-content:space-between;

    align-items:flex-end;

    gap:12px;

    margin-bottom:16px;

  }

  .module-summary{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:14px 26px;}

  .module-summary .k{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--text-faint);}

  .module-summary .v{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:18px;font-weight:600;margin-top:3px;}



  .btn{

    background:var(--gold);

    color:#1a1506;

    border:none;

    padding:10px 18px;

    border-radius:8px;

    font-weight:700;

    font-size:13px;

    display:inline-flex;

    align-items:center;

    gap:7px;

  }

  .btn:hover{background:#dcb52f;}

  .btn.ghost{

    background:transparent;

    border:1px solid var(--border);

    color:var(--text-dim);

    font-weight:600;

  }

  .btn.ghost:hover{color:var(--text);border-color:var(--gold-soft);}

  .btn.small{padding:6px 12px;font-size:12px;}

  .btn.danger-ghost{

    background:transparent;border:1px solid var(--rust-dim);color:var(--rust);font-weight:600;

  }

  .btn.danger-ghost:hover{background:var(--rust-dim);}



  .entry-card{

    background:var(--surface);

    border:1px solid var(--border-soft);

    border-radius:var(--radius);

    margin-bottom:12px;

    overflow:hidden;

  }

  .entry-main{

    display:grid;

    grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.4fr) minmax(0,.9fr) minmax(0,.9fr) minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr) auto;

    gap:8px 10px;

    align-items:center;

    padding:16px 18px;

    cursor:pointer;

  }

  .entry-main > div{min-width:0;}

  .entry-person, .col-value{overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;}

  .entry-main:hover{background:var(--surface-alt);}

  .entry-person{font-weight:600;font-size:14.5px;}

  .entry-person .badge{

    display:inline-block;

    font-size:10px;

    font-family:var(--mono);

    padding:1px 7px;

    border-radius:20px;

    margin-left:8px;

    vertical-align:1px;

  }

  .badge.open{background:var(--gold-soft);color:#fff2c9;}

  .badge.settled{background:var(--green-dim);color:#bdeedb;}

  .entry-meta{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--text-faint);margin-top:3px;}

  .col-label{font-size:10.5px;color:var(--text-faint);margin-bottom:3px;}

  .col-value{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:14px;font-weight:600;}

  .chevron{

    color:var(--text-faint);

    transition:transform .18s ease;

  }

  .entry-card.expanded .chevron{transform:rotate(180deg);}



  .entry-detail{

    display:none;

    border-top:1px solid var(--border-soft);

    padding:16px 18px 18px;

    background:var(--surface-alt);

  }

  .entry-card.expanded .entry-detail{display:block;}



  .detail-grid{

    display:grid;

    grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;

    gap:20px;

  }

  .pay-table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:13px;}

  .pay-table th{

    text-align:left;

    font-size:10.5px;

    color:var(--text-faint);

    font-weight:600;

    padding-bottom:8px;

    border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-soft);

  }

  .pay-table td{

    padding:8px 0;

    border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-soft);

  }

  .pay-table td.amt{font-family:var(--mono);}

  .pay-table tr:last-child td{border-bottom:none;}

  .mini-form{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-top:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;}

  .mini-form input{

    background:var(--surface);

    border:1px solid var(--border);

    color:var(--text);

    padding:8px 10px;

    border-radius:7px;

    font-size:13px;

    min-width:0;

  }

  .mini-form input[type=date]{color-scheme:dark;}

  .mini-form input.amt-input{width:120px;flex:1 1 100px;}

  .mini-form input.date-input{width:150px;flex:1 1 140px;}

  .mini-form .btn{flex:0 0 auto;}



  .calc-row{

    display:flex;

    justify-content:space-between;

    padding:7px 0;

    font-size:13px;

    border-bottom:1px dashed var(--border-soft);

  }

  .calc-row:last-child{border-bottom:none;padding-top:10px;}

  .calc-row .cv{font-family:var(--mono);font-weight:600;}

  .calc-row.total .cv{font-size:16px;color:var(--gold);}



  .del-row-btn{

    background:none;border:none;color:var(--text-faint);

    padding:2px 6px;font-size:12px;

  }

  .del-row-btn:hover{color:var(--rust);}



  .empty-state{

    text-align:center;

    padding:60px 20px;

    color:var(--text-faint);

  }

  .empty-state .es-icon{font-size:34px;margin-bottom:10px;opacity:.6;}

  .empty-state h4{font-family:var(--serif);color:var(--text-dim);font-size:18px;margin:0 0 6px;}



  /* ---------- Modal ---------- */

  .overlay{

    position:fixed;inset:0;

    background:rgba(6,8,11,.6);

    display:none;

    align-items:center;justify-content:center;

    z-index:100;

    padding:20px;

  }

  .overlay.show{display:flex;}

  .modal{

    background:var(--surface);

    border:1px solid var(--border);

    border-radius:12px;

    width:420px;

    max-width:100%;

    max-height:88vh;

    overflow-y:auto;

    box-shadow:0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.5);

  }

  .modal-head{

    display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;

    padding:18px 20px;

    border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-soft);

  }

  .modal-head h3{margin:0;font-family:var(--serif);font-size:18px;}

  .modal-close{background:none;border:none;color:var(--text-faint);font-size:20px;line-height:1;padding:2px 6px;}

  .modal-close:hover{color:var(--text);}

  .modal-body{padding:18px 20px 22px;}

  .field{margin-bottom:14px;}

  .field label{display:block;font-size:12px;color:var(--text-dim);margin-bottom:6px;}

  .field input,.field select{

    width:100%;

    background:var(--surface-alt);

    border:1px solid var(--border);

    color:var(--text);

    padding:10px 12px;

    border-radius:8px;

    font-size:14px;

  }

  .field input:focus,.field select:focus,.mini-form input:focus{

    outline:none;border-color:var(--gold-soft);

  }

  .field input[type=date]{color-scheme:dark;}

  .field-row{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;}

  .field-row .field{flex:1 1 140px;min-width:0;}

  .field-hint{font-size:11px;color:var(--text-faint);margin-top:5px;}

  .type-toggle{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-bottom:16px;}

  .type-opt{

    flex:1;

    text-align:center;

    padding:10px;

    border-radius:8px;

    border:1px solid var(--border);

    background:var(--surface-alt);

    color:var(--text-dim);

    font-weight:600;

    font-size:13px;

  }

  .type-opt.sel-borrowed{border-color:var(--rust);color:var(--rust);background:var(--rust-dim);}

  .type-opt.sel-lent{border-color:var(--green);color:var(--green);background:var(--green-dim);}

  .modal-actions{display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;gap:10px;margin-top:6px;}



  .toast{

    position:fixed;bottom:24px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);

    background:var(--raised);

    border:1px solid var(--border);

    color:var(--text);

    padding:11px 20px;

    border-radius:9px;

    font-size:13px;

    z-index:200;

    opacity:0;

    pointer-events:none;

    transition:opacity .2s ease, transform .2s ease;

  }

  .toast.show{opacity:1;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(-4px);}



  .placeholder-view{

    padding:70px 20px;

    text-align:center;

    color:var(--text-faint);

  }

  .placeholder-view .pv-icon{font-size:30px;margin-bottom:12px;opacity:.5;}

  .placeholder-view h3{font-family:var(--serif);color:var(--text-dim);font-size:19px;margin:0 0 8px;}



  /* ---------- PIN lock ---------- */

  .lock-screen{

    position:fixed;inset:0;

    background:var(--bg);

    z-index:500;

    display:flex;

    align-items:center;

    justify-content:center;

    padding:20px;

  }

  .lock-screen.hidden{display:none;}

  .lock-card{

    width:100%;

    max-width:320px;

    text-align:center;

  }

  .lock-brand{

    font-family:var(--serif);

    font-weight:600;

    font-size:24px;

    color:var(--gold);

    margin-bottom:26px;

  }

  .lock-title{

    font-family:var(--serif);

    font-size:19px;

    font-weight:600;

    margin-bottom:5px;

  }

  .lock-sub{

    font-size:12.5px;

    color:var(--text-faint);

    margin-bottom:22px;

  }

  .pin-dots{

    display:flex;

    justify-content:center;

    gap:16px;

    margin-bottom:14px;

  }

  .pin-dots .dot{

    width:14px;height:14px;

    border-radius:50%;

    border:1.5px solid var(--border);

    background:transparent;

    transition:background .12s ease, border-color .12s ease, transform .12s ease;

  }

  .pin-dots .dot.filled{

    background:var(--gold);

    border-color:var(--gold);

    transform:scale(1.1);

  }

  .lock-card.shake .pin-dots{animation:shakeDots .32s ease;}

  @keyframes shakeDots{

    0%,100%{transform:translateX(0);}

    25%{transform:translateX(-8px);}

    75%{transform:translateX(8px);}

  }

  .pin-error{

    min-height:18px;

    color:var(--rust);

    font-size:12.5px;

    margin-bottom:14px;

  }

  .keypad{

    display:grid;

    grid-template-columns:repeat(3, 64px);

    gap:14px;

    justify-content:center;

    margin-bottom:20px;

  }

  .key{

    width:64px;height:64px;

    border-radius:50%;

    background:var(--surface);

    border:1px solid var(--border-soft);

    color:var(--text);

    font-size:20px;

    font-family:var(--mono);

    font-weight:500;

    display:flex;

    align-items:center;

    justify-content:center;

  }

<script>

(function(){

  var LOAN_ACCOUNTS_KEY = 'ledger-loan-accounts-v1';

  var CREDIT_CARDS_KEY = 'ledger-credit-cards-v1';

  var creditCards = [];

  var editingCardId = null;

  var cardEmiModalCardId = null;   // which card's "add EMI" modal is open

  var editingCardEmiId = null;     // which EMI (on that card) is being edited

  var savedPin = null;

  var lockContext = 'boot';   // 'boot' (app start) or 'change' (changing an existing PIN)

  var lockMode = 'enter';     // enter | create | confirm | verify-current | new | confirm-new

  var pendingNewPin = '';

  function fmtDate(iso){

    if(!iso) return '—';

    var d = new Date(iso + 'T00:00:00');

    return d.toLocaleDateString('en-IN', { day:'2-digit', month:'short', year:'numeric' });

  }



  function fmtMoney(n){

    n = Math.round(n);

    var neg = n < 0;

    n = Math.abs(n);

    var s = '₹' + n.toLocaleString('en-IN');

    return neg ? '−' + s : s;

  }



  function daysBetween(a, b){

    var d1 = new Date(a + 'T00:00:00');

    var d2 = new Date(b + 'T00:00:00');

  /* ============ Persistence ============ */

  function loadPaidMarks(cb){

    if(storageOk){

      try{

        var raw = localStorage.getItem(PAID_MARKS_KEY);

        if(raw){

          var parsed = JSON.parse(raw);

          if(parsed && typeof parsed === 'object') paidMarks = parsed;

        }

      }catch(e){ console.error('Could not read saved paid marks', e); }

    }

    prunePaidMarks();

    cb();

  }



  // Drop paid-marks whose due date is more than 45 days in the past —

  // by then that cycle is long gone and the mark serves no purpose.

  function prunePaidMarks(){

    var cutoff = todayISO();

    var changed = false;

    Object.keys(paidMarks).forEach(function(key){

      var parts = key.split(':');

      var dueDate = parts[parts.length - 1];

      if(dueDate && daysBetween(dueDate, cutoff) > 45){

        delete paidMarks[key];

        changed = true;

      }

    });

    if(changed) savePaidMarks();

  }



  function savePaidMarks(){

    if(!storageOk){ showToast('Storage is blocked in this browser — changes won\'t be saved'); return; }

    try{

      localStorage.setItem(PAID_MARKS_KEY, JSON.stringify(paidMarks));

    }catch(e){ showToast('Could not save — storage may be full or blocked'); }

  }



  /* ============ Interest engine ============ */

  // Simple interest, non-compounding, on a reducing principal balance.

  // Payments are applied to principal. Interest is accrued day-by-day

  // on whatever principal was outstanding in each interval.

  function calcEntry(entry, asOf){

    asOf = asOf || todayISO();

    var rate = Number(entry.rate) || 0;

    var outstanding = Number(entry.amount) || 0;

    var accrued = 0;

    var prevDate = entry.date;



    var payments = (entry.payments || [])

      .filter(function(p){ return p.date <= asOf; })

      .slice()

      .sort(function(a,b){ return a.date < b.date ? -1 : 1; });



    payments.forEach(function(p){

      var days = daysBetween(prevDate, p.date);

      accrued += outstanding * (rate/100) * (days/365);

      outstanding -= Number(p.amount) || 0;

      if(outstanding < 0) outstanding = 0;

      prevDate = p.date;

    });



    var tailDays = daysBetween(prevDate, asOf);

    accrued += outstanding * (rate/100) * (tailDays/365);



    var paidTotal = (entry.payments || []).reduce(function(s,p){ return s + (Number(p.amount)||0); }, 0);

    var isSettled = outstanding <= 0.5;



    return {

      outstandingPrincipal: outstanding,

      accruedInterest: accrued,

      totalDue: outstanding + accrued,

      paidTotal: paidTotal,

      isSettled: isSettled

    };

  }



  function allEntriesWithCalc(type){

    return state[type].map(function(e){ return { entry:e, calc: calcEntry(e) }; });

  }



  /* ============ EMI loan engine ============ */

  // Standard reducing-balance EMI math. monthlyRate is a decimal (e.g. 0.0075 for 9% p.a.).

  function emiFromRate(principal, monthlyRate, tenureMonths){

    if(monthlyRate <= 0) return principal / tenureMonths;

    var f = Math.pow(1 + monthlyRate, tenureMonths);

    return principal * monthlyRate * f / (f - 1);

  }



  // Solves for the monthly rate that produces a given EMI, via bisection.

  // Returns null if the EMI is too low to ever pay off the principal.

  function rateFromEMI(principal, emiTarget, tenureMonths){

    var minEmi = principal / tenureMonths;

    if(emiTarget <= minEmi + 0.01) return 0;

    var lo = 0, hi = 0.08, guard = 0;

    while(emiFromRate(principal, hi, tenureMonths) < emiTarget && guard < 60){ hi *= 1.6; guard++; }

    if(guard >= 60) return null;

    for(var i = 0; i < 80; i++){

      var mid = (lo + hi) / 2;

      if(emiFromRate(principal, mid, tenureMonths) > emiTarget) hi = mid; else lo = mid;

    }

    return (lo + hi) / 2;

  }



  function monthsElapsed(dateISO, asOfISO){

    var d1 = new Date(dateISO + 'T00:00:00');

    var d2 = new Date(asOfISO + 'T00:00:00');

    var months = (d2.getFullYear() - d1.getFullYear()) * 12 + (d2.getMonth() - d1.getMonth());

    if(d2.getDate() < d1.getDate()) months -= 1;

    return Math.max(0, months);

  }



  function addMonths(dateISO, n){

    var d = new Date(dateISO + 'T00:00:00');

    d.setMonth(d.getMonth() + n);

    return d.toISOString().slice(0, 10);

  }



  // Full derived numbers for a loan account, as of today.

  function calcLoan(loan, asOf){

    asOf = asOf || todayISO();

    var P = Number(loan.principal) || 0;

    var n = Number(loan.tenure) || 0;

    var r = Number(loan.monthlyRate) || 0;

    var emi = Number(loan.emi) || 0;



    var elapsed = monthsElapsed(loan.date, asOf);

    var paidCount = Math.min(elapsed, n);



    var balance = P;

    if(r > 0){

      var f = Math.pow(1 + r, paidCount);

      balance = P * f - emi * ((f - 1) / r);

    } else {

      balance = P - emi * paidCount;

    }

    if(balance < 0) balance = 0;



    var principalRepaid = P - balance;

    var totalPaid = emi * paidCount;

    var interestPaid = totalPaid - principalRepaid;

    var remainingMonths = Math.max(0, n - paidCount);

    var isCompleted = paidCount >= n || balance <= 1;

    var nextDueDate = isCompleted ? null : addMonths(loan.date, paidCount + 1);

    var totalInterestFullTenure = emi * n - P;

    var annualRatePercent = r * 12 * 100;



    return {

      emi: emi,

      annualRatePercent: annualRatePercent,

      paidCount: paidCount,

      remainingMonths: remainingMonths,

      outstandingBalance: balance,

      principalRepaid: principalRepaid,

      interestPaidToDate: interestPaid,

      totalInterestFullTenure: totalInterestFullTenure,

      totalPayable: P + totalInterestFullTenure,

      nextDueDate: nextDueDate,

      isCompleted: isCompleted

    };

  }



  function allLoansWithCalc(){

    return loanAccounts.map(function(l){ return { loan: l, calc: calcLoan(l) }; });

  }



  function buildSchedule(loan){

    var P = Number(loan.principal) || 0;

    var n = Number(loan.tenure) || 0;

    var r = Number(loan.monthlyRate) || 0;

    var emi = Number(loan.emi) || 0;

    var balance = P;

    var rows = [];

    for(var i = 1; i <= n; i++){

      var interest = r > 0 ? balance * r : 0;

      var principalPart = emi - interest;

      var rowEmi = emi;

      if(i === n || principalPart > balance){

        principalPart = balance;

        rowEmi = principalPart + interest;

      }

      balance = Math.max(0, balance - principalPart);

      rows.push({

        month: i,

        date: addMonths(loan.date, i),

        emi: rowEmi,

        interest: interest,

        principal: principalPart,

        balance: balance

      });

    }

    return rows;

  }



  /* ============ Credit card engine ============ */

  // A credit card has: name, issuer/network, total limit, bill cycle date (1-28,

  // the day of month the statement closes), optional due-day offset, and a list

  // of EMIs converted on that card. Each EMI behaves like a mini fixed-tenure

  // loan (no interest math shown — EMI amount + tenure is entered directly,

  // since card EMI interest is usually already baked into the flat EMI amount).



  // Next bill/statement date on or after `asOf`, given the cycle day-of-month.

  function nextCycleDate(cycleDay, asOfISO){

    var d = new Date(asOfISO + 'T00:00:00');

    var y = d.getFullYear(), m = d.getMonth();

    var candidate = new Date(y, m, cycleDay);

    if(candidate < d) candidate = new Date(y, m + 1, cycleDay);

    return candidate.toISOString().slice(0, 10);

  }



  function calcCardEmi(emi, asOf){

    asOf = asOf || todayISO();

    var amount = Number(emi.amount) || 0;

    var tenure = Number(emi.tenure) || 0;

    var elapsed = monthsElapsed(emi.startDate, asOf);

    var paidCount = Math.min(elapsed, tenure);

    var remaining = Math.max(0, tenure - paidCount);

    var isCompleted = paidCount >= tenure;

    var nextDueDate = isCompleted ? null : addMonths(emi.startDate, paidCount + 1);

    return {

      paidCount: paidCount,

      remaining: remaining,

      isCompleted: isCompleted,

      nextDueDate: nextDueDate,

      totalOutstanding: amount * remaining,

      totalValue: amount * tenure

    };

  }



  // Full derived numbers for one credit card, as of today.

  function calcCard(card, asOf){

    asOf = asOf || todayISO();

    var emis = (card.emis || []).map(function(e){ return { emi: e, calc: calcCardEmi(e, asOf) }; });

    var activeEmis = emis.filter(function(x){ return !x.calc.isCompleted; });

    var monthlyEmiOutflow = activeEmis.reduce(function(s,x){ return s + (Number(x.emi.amount)||0); }, 0);

    var emiOutstanding = emis.reduce(function(s,x){ return s + x.calc.totalOutstanding; }, 0);



    var cycleDay = Math.min(28, Math.max(1, Number(card.cycleDay) || 1));

    var nextBillDate = nextCycleDate(cycleDay, asOf);

    var dueOffset = Number(card.dueOffsetDays) || 18; // days after statement the bill is due

    var d = new Date(nextBillDate + 'T00:00:00');

    d.setDate(d.getDate() + dueOffset);

    var nextDueDate = d.toISOString().slice(0, 10);



    var nextActiveEmi = activeEmis

      .filter(function(x){ return x.calc.nextDueDate; })

      .sort(function(a,b){ return a.calc.nextDueDate < b.calc.nextDueDate ? -1 : 1; })[0] || null;



    var limit = Number(card.limit) || 0;

    var utilization = limit > 0 ? Math.min(100, Math.round((emiOutstanding / limit) * 100)) : 0;



    // Bill history — each entry has { id, date, totalDue, minDue }. For each bill,

    // work out how much of the total was EMI (using the monthly EMI outflow at

    // that point) vs "extra" (fresh shopping/spend not from EMIs).

    var bills = (card.bills || []).slice().sort(function(a,b){ return a.date < b.date ? 1 : -1; }); // newest first

    var billsWithCalc = bills.map(function(b){

      var totalDue = Number(b.totalDue) || 0;

      var minDue = Number(b.minDue) || 0;

      // EMI portion of that bill is capped at whatever the total bill was.

      var emiPortion = Math.min(monthlyEmiOutflow, totalDue);

      var extraSpend = Math.max(0, totalDue - emiPortion);

      return { bill: b, totalDue: totalDue, minDue: minDue, emiPortion: emiPortion, extraSpend: extraSpend };

    });

    var latestBill = billsWithCalc.length ? billsWithCalc[0] : null;



    return {

      emis: emis,

      activeEmiCount: activeEmis.length,

      monthlyEmiOutflow: monthlyEmiOutflow,

      emiOutstanding: emiOutstanding,

      nextBillDate: nextBillDate,

      nextDueDate: nextDueDate,

      nextActiveEmi: nextActiveEmi,

      utilization: utilization,

      bills: billsWithCalc,

      latestBill: latestBill

    };

  }



  function allCardsWithCalc(){

    return creditCards.map(function(c){ return { card: c, calc: calcCard(c) }; });

  }



  /* ============ Rendering ============ */

  var content = document.getElementById('content');

  function buildNotifications(borrowed, lent, loans, cards){

    var out = [];

    borrowed.filter(function(x){ return !x.calc.isSettled; })

      .sort(function(a,b){ return b.calc.totalDue - a.calc.totalDue; })

      .slice(0,3)

      .forEach(function(x){

        out.push({

          level: 'warn',

          text: 'You owe <b>' + x.entry.person + '</b> ' + fmtMoney(x.calc.totalDue) + ' (principal + interest to date)',

          time: 'Borrowed on ' + fmtDate(x.entry.date)

        });

      });

    lent.filter(function(x){ return !x.calc.isSettled; })

      .sort(function(a,b){ return b.calc.totalDue - a.calc.totalDue; })

      .slice(0,3)

      .forEach(function(x){

        out.push({

          level: 'info',

          text: '<b>' + x.entry.person + '</b> owes you ' + fmtMoney(x.calc.totalDue) + ' (principal + interest to date)',

          time: 'Lent on ' + fmtDate(x.entry.date)

        });

      });

    var settledRecent = borrowed.concat(lent).filter(function(x){ return x.calc.isSettled; }).length;

    if(settledRecent > 0){

      out.push({ level:'ok', text: settledRecent + ' loan' + (settledRecent>1?'s are':' is') + ' fully settled', time:'Up to date' });

    }



    if(loans && loans.length){

      var today = todayISO();

      loans.filter(function(x){ return !x.calc.isCompleted && x.calc.nextDueDate; })

        .sort(function(a,b){ return a.calc.nextDueDate < b.calc.nextDueDate ? -1 : 1; })

        .forEach(function(x){

          var daysAway = daysBetween(today, x.calc.nextDueDate);

          if(daysAway <= 7){

            out.push({

              level: 'warn',

              text: 'EMI of ' + fmtMoney(x.calc.emi) + ' for <b>' + x.loan.name + '</b> is due ' + (daysAway===0 ? 'today' : 'on ' + fmtDate(x.calc.nextDueDate)),

              time: x.calc.remainingMonths + ' month' + (x.calc.remainingMonths===1?'':'s') + ' remaining'

            });

          }

        });

      var completedLoans = loans.filter(function(x){ return x.calc.isCompleted; }).length;

      if(completedLoans > 0){

        out.push({ level:'ok', text: completedLoans + ' EMI loan' + (completedLoans>1?'s are':' is') + ' fully paid off', time:'Up to date' });

      }

    }



    if(cards && cards.length){

      var today2 = todayISO();

      cards.slice()

        .sort(function(a,b){ return a.calc.nextDueDate < b.calc.nextDueDate ? -1 : 1; })

        .forEach(function(x){

          var daysAway = daysBetween(today2, x.calc.nextDueDate);

          if(daysAway <= 7){

            out.push({

              level: 'warn',

              text: 'Credit card bill for <b>' + escapeHtml(x.card.name) + '</b> (' + fmtMoney(x.calc.latestBill ? x.calc.latestBill.totalDue : x.calc.monthlyEmiOutflow) + ') is due ' + (daysAway===0 ? 'today' : 'on ' + fmtDate(x.calc.nextDueDate)),

              time: x.calc.activeEmiCount + ' active EMI' + (x.calc.activeEmiCount===1?'':'s') + ' on this card'

            });

          }

        });

      var highUtil = cards.filter(function(x){ return x.calc.utilization >= 70; }).length;

      if(highUtil > 0){

        out.push({ level:'warn', text: highUtil + ' credit card' + (highUtil>1?'s are':' is') + ' at 70%+ of its limit (from EMIs)', time:'Check utilization' });

      }

    }



    return out;

  }

    var date = document.getElementById('lf-date').value;

    var tenure = parseInt(document.getElementById('lf-tenure').value, 10);



    if(!name){ showToast('Enter the loan or lender name'); return; }

    if(!principal || principal <= 0){ showToast('Enter a valid principal amount'); return; }

    if(!date){ showToast('Pick the date the loan was taken'); return; }

    if(!tenure || tenure <= 0){ showToast('Enter a valid tenure in months'); return; }



    var monthlyRate, emi, rateInputVal;



    if(loanRateMode === 'rate'){

      rateInputVal = parseFloat(document.getElementById('lf-rate').value);

      if(isNaN(rateInputVal) || rateInputVal < 0){ showToast('Enter a valid interest rate (0 if interest-free)'); return; }

      monthlyRate = rateInputVal / 12 / 100;

      emi = emiFromRate(principal, monthlyRate, tenure);

    } else {

      var emiInputVal = parseFloat(document.getElementById('lf-emi').value);

      if(!emiInputVal || emiInputVal <= 0){ showToast('Enter a valid EMI amount'); return; }

      var solved = rateFromEMI(principal, emiInputVal, tenure);

      if(solved === null){ showToast('This EMI is too low to pay off the loan in that tenure'); return; }

      monthlyRate = solved;

      emi = emiInputVal;

    }



    var record = {

      id: editingLoanId || uid(),

      name: name,

      principal: principal,

      date: date,

      tenure: tenure,

      rateMode: loanRateMode,

      rate: loanRateMode === 'rate' ? rateInputVal : (monthlyRate*12*100),

      emi: emi,

      monthlyRate: monthlyRate

    };



    if(editingLoanId){

      var idx = loanAccounts.findIndex(function(l){ return l.id === editingLoanId; });

      loanAccounts[idx] = record;

    } else {

      loanAccounts.push(record);

    }

    saveLoanAccounts();

    closeModal();

    render();

    showToast('Loan saved');

  function saveCardEmi(){
    var label = document.getElementById('cef-label').value.trim();
    var amount = parseFloat(document.getElementById('cef-amount').value);
    var tenure = parseInt(document.getElementById('cef-tenure').value, 10);
    var paidCount = parseInt(document.getElementById('cef-paid').value, 10);
    if(isNaN(paidCount) || paidCount < 0) paidCount = 0;

    if(!label){ showToast('Enter what this EMI is for'); return; }
    if(!amount || amount <= 0){ showToast('Enter a valid EMI amount'); return; }
    if(!tenure || tenure <= 0){ showToast('Enter a valid tenure in months'); return; }
    if(paidCount > tenure){ showToast('EMIs paid can\'t be more than total tenure'); return; }

    // Derive a start date such that "months already paid" lines up as of today —
    // the rest of the engine (calcCardEmi) works off this start date.
    var startDate = addMonths(todayISO(), -paidCount);

    var card = creditCards.find(function(c){ return c.id === cardEmiModalCardId; });
    if(!card){ showToast('Card not found'); return; }
    card.emis = card.emis || [];

    if(editingCardEmiId){
      var idx = card.emis.findIndex(function(e){ return e.id === editingCardEmiId; });
      if(idx > -1) card.emis[idx] = { id: editingCardEmiId, label: label, amount: amount, tenure: tenure, startDate: startDate };
    } else {
      card.emis.push({ id: uid(), label: label, amount: amount, tenure: tenure, startDate: startDate });
    }

    saveCreditCards();
    closeModal();
    render();
    showToast('EMI saved');
  }

  /* ============ PIN lock ============ */

  var lockScreenEl = document.getElementById('lockScreen');

  var lockCardEl = document.getElementById('lockCard');

  var lockTitleEl = document.getElementById('lockTitle');

  var lockSubEl = document.getElementById('lockSub');

  var pinErrorEl = document.getElementById('pinError');

  var lockCancelBtn = document.getElementById('lockCancelBtn');



  function updateDots(){

    var dots = lockCardEl.querySelectorAll('.pin-dots .dot');

    dots.forEach(function(dot,i){ dot.classList.toggle('filled', i < pinBuffer.length); });

  }



  function pinError(msg){

    pinErrorEl.textContent = msg;

  }



  function shakeCard(){

    lockCardEl.classList.remove('shake');

    void lockCardEl.offsetWidth; // restart animation

    lockCardEl.classList.add('shake');

  }



  function renderLock(){

    pinError('');

    updateDots();

    lockCancelBtn.style.display = (lockContext === 'change') ? 'inline-flex' : 'none';



    if(lockMode === 'enter'){

      lockTitleEl.textContent = 'Enter PIN';

      lockSubEl.textContent = 'Enter your PIN to unlock Ledger';

    } else if(lockMode === 'create'){

      lockTitleEl.textContent = 'Create a PIN';

      lockSubEl.textContent = 'Set a 4-digit PIN to protect your ledger';

    } else if(lockMode === 'confirm'){

      lockTitleEl.textContent = 'Confirm PIN';

      lockSubEl.textContent = 'Enter the same PIN again';

    } else if(lockMode === 'verify-current'){

      lockTitleEl.textContent = 'Enter current PIN';

      lockSubEl.textContent = 'Confirm it\'s you before changing your PIN';

    } else if(lockMode === 'new'){

      lockTitleEl.textContent = 'Enter new PIN';

      lockSubEl.textContent = 'Choose a new 4-digit PIN';

    } else if(lockMode === 'confirm-new'){

      lockTitleEl.textContent = 'Confirm new PIN';

      lockSubEl.textContent = 'Enter the same PIN again';

    }

  }



  function showLockScreen(){

    lockScreenEl.classList.remove('hidden');

  }

  function hideLockScreen(){

    lockScreenEl.classList.add('hidden');

  }



  function unlockApp(){

    pinBuffer = '';

    hideLockScreen();

  }



  function closeLockOverlay(){

    pinBuffer = '';

    pendingNewPin = '';

    lockContext = 'boot';

    lockMode = 'enter';

    hideLockScreen();

  }



  function processPin(){

    if(lockMode === 'enter'){

      if(pinBuffer === savedPin){

        unlockApp();

      } else {

        pinError('Incorrect PIN');

        shakeCard();

        pinBuffer = '';

        updateDots();

      }

    } else if(lockMode === 'create'){

      pendingNewPin = pinBuffer;

      pinBuffer = '';

      lockMode = 'confirm';

      renderLock();

    } else if(lockMode === 'confirm'){

      if(pinBuffer === pendingNewPin){

        savedPin = pinBuffer;

        pinBuffer = ''; pendingNewPin = '';

        savePin(savedPin, function(){ unlockApp(); });

      } else {

        pendingNewPin = '';

        pinBuffer = '';

        lockMode = 'create';

        renderLock();

        pinError('PINs didn\'t match — try again');

      }

    } else if(lockMode === 'verify-current'){

      if(pinBuffer === savedPin){

        pinBuffer = '';

        lockMode = 'new';

        renderLock();

      } else {

        pinError('Incorrect current PIN');

        shakeCard();

        pinBuffer = '';

        updateDots();

      }

    } else if(lockMode === 'new'){

      pendingNewPin = pinBuffer;

      pinBuffer = '';

      lockMode = 'confirm-new';

      renderLock();

    } else if(lockMode === 'confirm-new'){

      if(pinBuffer === pendingNewPin){

        savedPin = pinBuffer;

        pinBuffer = ''; pendingNewPin = '';

        savePin(savedPin, function(){

          showToast('PIN updated');

          closeLockOverlay();

        });

      } else {

        pendingNewPin = '';

        pinBuffer = '';

        lockMode = 'new';

        renderLock();

        pinError('PINs didn\'t match — try again');

      }

    }

  }



  function pinDigit(d){

    if(pinBuffer.length >= 4) return;

    pinBuffer += d;

    updateDots();

    if(pinBuffer.length === 4){

  }



  function pinBackspace(){

    pinBuffer = pinBuffer.slice(0, -1);
